title: FPIs pump Rs 13,010 crore into Indian equities in second half of August
raw_summary: Overseas investors continued buying Indian equities for five straight fortnights. They invested over thirteen thousand crore rupees in the latter half of August. Oil, gas, and consumable fuels experienced the largest foreign investment outflows.
